say: This video shows how to print a patient's PVC card in HMIS. The front and the back are printed separately, one side at a time.
Open the OPD menu and click Patient Lookup and Registration.
Find the patient. Here we type the phone number into Quick Search.
The patient profile opens. At the top are two buttons: Print Front, and Print Back.
Put a blank card in the card printer, and click Print Front.
The browser's print dialog opens. Choose your card printer, set Margins to None and Scale to 100 percent, then click Print.
This is the printed front: the artwork, with the patient's name, date of birth, phone number, gender and PHN.
Now turn the card over and put it back in the printer.
Click Print Back, and print it with the same settings.
The back carries the barcode and the PHN. Staff can scan the barcode at the counter to find the patient.
To change what is printed, or where, use PVC Card Layout under Administration, shown in the previous video.
